name: dossier-bump
pr_title: docs({{service}}): move the dossier to the service's current main
prompt:
Bring the architecture dossier of the service {{service}} up to the service's current main branch.

Where things are:
- This repository is TAIPANBOX/architecture. Read its CLAUDE.md and docs/examples/example.md before changing anything.
- The dossier is services/{{service}}.md. Its frontmatter field verified_at is the service commit the dossier was last checked against, and verified is that date.
- The service's main branch is checked out read-only at ../context/{{service}}. Use `git -C ../context/{{service}} log --stat <verified_at>..HEAD` to see what changed and `git -C ../context/{{service}} show <sha>` to read a change. `git -C ../context/{{service}} rev-parse HEAD` is the new commit.

What to do:
1. Read the changes since verified_at. Re-read only the dossier sections those changes touch and correct every statement they made false. Cite the commit for each correction, as the dossier already does.
2. Set verified_at to the new commit and verified to today's date (UTC).
3. Add to section 11 a short entry saying what merged since the previous verified_at.
4. Run `make build`, then `./bin/archguard render-index` to regenerate README.md.
5. Run `make gates`. Every gate must pass before you finish.

Rules: change only services/{{service}}.md and README.md. Mark your own conclusions @claude. Never quote a person and never attribute a decision to the owner by name. No long dashes anywhere. If a change is too large or unclear to describe from the code, say so in section 11 instead of guessing.

Finish with a short reply: what you changed and why, what you ran and what it printed, and what you did not verify.
